EVAL-CT-M2-S1.title: Recruitment Status Schema and Scoring Contract
EVAL-CT-M2-S1.description: Define canonical schema for clinical trial recruitment status (RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, UNKNOWN) and map each status to a normalized score contribution with explicit defaults and versioned contract for downstream compatibility.

EVAL-CT-M2-S2.title: Recruitment Status Extraction and Normalization
EVAL-CT-M2-S2.description: Implement extraction of recruitment status from ClinicalTrials.gov API payloads and normalize to schema values, including handling of nulls, unexpected enums, and legacy status strings with defensive parsing.

EVAL-CT-M2-S3.title: Recruitment Status Scoring Logic
EVAL-CT-M2-S3.description: Implement deterministic scoring function assigning highest weight to RECRUITING trials, moderate to ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, and lowest to COMPLETED/TERMINATED, with safe fallback for UNKNOWN and explicit weighting constants for auditability.

EVAL-CT-M2-S4.title: Expose Recruitment Status Score via EvaluateCare Facade
EVAL-CT-M2-S4.description: Integrate recruitment status score into clinical trial evaluation response and expose through evaluate_care_facade with stable field naming (e.g., recruitment_status_score, recruitment_status_label) and alignment with existing response models.

EVAL-CT-M2-S5.title: Recruitment Status Unit and Integration Tests
EVAL-CT-M2-S5.description: Add unit tests for normalization and scoring edge cases (unknown, malformed, missing) and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from ClinicalTrials.gov ingestion through scoring and facade output contract.
EVAL-CT-M2-S5.evidence: GAP: No existing unit/integration tests for clinical trial evaluation scoring; new test suite must be created
